description: Every approval that waits for a decision, oldest first. They survive a restart.
emptyText: As soon as a run reaches an approval node, it appears here.
nothingToShow: No results arrive here; the review is about the process itself.
commentHint: Later agents can read the comment.
commentFirst: Give a reason for the rejection first.
rejectBranch: When rejected, the run continues on the “Rejected” branch.
rejectEnds: When rejected, this path ends (no “Rejected” branch is connected).

tool.title: Tool call: {{name}}
tool.capabilityUnknown: Not classified: treated as changing and external
tool.arguments: Arguments, exactly as they will be sent
tool.expired: Time is up; the call counts as rejected.
tool.commentHint: The agent reads the comment; it is recorded with the decision.
tool.rejectHint: When rejected, the call is not made and the agent learns that it was refused. Without a decision, the call counts as rejected.
tool.rejectedToast: Rejected. The call is not made.
tool.runWaiting: This run waits for your decision on a tool call.

rules.title: Rules for tool calls
rules.enabledText: Tool calls that change data or reach outside wait for a person's decision.
rules.disabledText: Nodestro does not ask before tool calls yet. Order: mark the existing assignments here, review the list, then the administrator switches approvals on (NODESTRO_TOOL_APPROVALS=1) after the security review.
rules.legacyText: Tool assignments that existed before approvals per call keep working without a question, bound to the tool version they ran with. A new version or a new assignment is asked about as usual. Tools of connected services are always asked about.
rules.legacyNotRun: The activation step has not run yet.
rules.legacyNone: No exceptions: no existing assignment needed one.
rules.stampHint: Do this before switching approvals on, then review the list. It marks the assignments that exist now in workflows, versions and published releases (their digest changes once) and runs only once.
rules.preGrantsText: Runs nobody watches (schedules, batches, test series) cannot ask. An approval in advance lets one tool version through for exactly one schedule, batch or test series. It ends with a new tool version, its expiry or when it is revoked. Tools that delete or destroy and tools of connected services cannot be approved in advance.
rules.revoked: Revoked. It no longer applies from the next call on.
rules.newGrantHint: Only tools that change data are listed; tools that only read need no approval.
rules.chooseScope: Choose a schedule, batch or test series
rules.expiresHint: Without a date it applies until revoked or until a new tool version.
rules.auditText: Who decided, granted or revoked what, and every refused decision. The arguments of a call are never stored here.

auditKinds.switch_off: Closed because the setting is off

rules.ranAt: Marked on {{time}} by {{name}}. The step runs once: assignments made afterwards are asked about.
